purpose: Development-only training-density ablation; not untouched qualification
featurePolicy: Existing118 historical structural/semantic features plus fixed128 spelling hashes; no base/vector prices in direct models
modelPolicy: Same100 iterations,15 leaves,min leaf20,rate0.1,seed17; absolute log-price center and10/90 quantiles; no random validation
calibrationPolicy: Saved stride50 development outcomes in [trainingUntil,evaluationFrom); same calibration events for sparse and dense
evaluationPolicy: All saved stride50 development attempts in each evaluation interval; report each fold and nonoverlapping pooled metrics, unique identities, all failures; cannot compare baseline interval score because endpoints are absent
